name_zh: 梅内姆/阿根廷/货币板/私有化/赦免/里奥哈/卡洛斯/可兑换
description_zh: 卡洛斯·梅内姆 (1930-) 阿根廷总统 (1989-1999) 实施货币板经济政策，推动大规模私有化改革，通过赦免政策解决债务危机，建立里奥哈家族政治网络，与美国建立紧密经济关系，推动阿根廷经济现代化，但也留下政治腐败和经济危机遗产。
description_en: Carlos Menem (1930-) Argentine President (1989-1999) implemented currency board economic policy, promoted large-scale privatization reforms, through amnesty policy solved debt crisis, established Rioja family political network, established close economic relations with United States, promoted Argentine economic modernization, but also left political corruption and economic crisis legacy.
reason_zh: 梅内姆代表拉美经济转型时期如何通过货币稳定换取政治改革，如何利用私有化实现经济振兴，以及政治赦免如何影响国家长期治理，体现了拉美经济改革的复杂性。
reason_en: Menem represents how Latin American economic transition period stabilizes currency through political reform, achieves economic revitalization through privatization, and political amnesty influences national long-term governance, embodies complexity of Latin American economic reform.
steps_zh: 研究梅内姆早年里奥哈政治生涯/货币板意识形成/经济思想
分析1989 年上台/货币板政策/大规模私有化改革
探讨赦免政策/债务危机/国际关系
评估货币板稳定/私有化改革/阿根廷经济
总结经济改革遗产/阿根廷现代国家/梅内姆主义
steps_en: Study Menem early Rioja political career/currency board idea/economic idea
Analyze 1989 accession/currency board policy/large-scale privatization reform
Evaluate currency board stabilization/private privatization reform/Argentine economy
Summarize economic reform legacy/Argentine modern state/Menemanism
expected_zh: 掌握货币板政策如何稳定国家经济，如何通过私有化实现经济振兴，以及赦免政策如何影响国家长期治理。
expected_en: Master how currency board policy stabilizes national economy, how privatization achieves economic revitalization, and how amnesty policy influences national long-term governance.
case_zh: 1991 货币板；1992 私有化；1993 赦免政策。货币板稳定/私有化改革/国际关系/阿根廷经济永存。
case_en: 1991 Currency Board; 1992 Privatization; 1993 Amnesty Policy. Currency board stabilization/Privatization reform/International relations/Argentine economy endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Argentine currency board/Privateization/Amnesty/Latin American economic reform
conflict_resolution_mechanism: 经济改革/国际关系/政治谈判
